questions.solution_md:
Formulalar: silindr $S=2\pi R(R+h)$, konus $S=\pi r(r+l)$, shar $S=4\pi R^2$.

$S_1=2\pi\cdot3(3+4)=42\pi$

questions.stem_md: Silindr o'q kesimining yuzi $160$ ga, asosining radiusi $8$ ga teng. Silindrning hajmini toping.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — tomonlari $2R$ va $h$ bo'lgan to'g'ri to'rtburchak: $S=2Rh$, bundan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{160}{16}=10$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot8^2\cdot10=640\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: O'q kesimi yuzini $Rh$ deb olish (diametr o'rniga radius): balandlik ikki barobar katta chiqib, hajm noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is a rectangle with sides $2R$ and $h$: $S=2Rh$, so $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{160}{16}=10$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot8^2\cdot10=640\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the section area as $Rh$ (radius instead of diameter): the height comes out twice too large.

questions.solution_md:
Formulalar: silindr $S=2\pi R(R+h)$, konus $S=\pi r(r+l)$, shar $S=4\pi R^2$.

$S_1=2\pi\cdot5(5+8)=130\pi$

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — tomonlari $2R$ va $h$ bo'lgan to'g'ri to'rtburchak: $S=2Rh$, bundan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{126}{18}=7$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot9^2\cdot7=567\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: O'q kesimi yuzini $Rh$ deb olish (diametr o'rniga radius): balandlik ikki barobar katta chiqib, hajm noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

kaa.solution_md:
Kósher kesim — tárepleri $2R$ hám $h$ bolǵan tuwrı tórtmúyeshlik: $S=2Rh$, bunnan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{96}{16}=6$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot8^2\cdot6=384\pi$.

ru.solution_md:
Осевое сечение — прямоугольник со сторонами $2R$ и $h$: $S=2Rh$, откуда $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{140}{14}=10$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot7^2\cdot10=490\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считать площадь сечения равной $Rh$ (радиус вместо диаметра): высота получается вдвое больше, объём неверный.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — tomonlari $2R$ va $h$ bo'lgan to'g'ri to'rtburchak: $S=2Rh$, bundan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{182}{14}=13$.

Formulas: cylinder $S=2\pi R(R+h)$, cone $S=\pi r(r+l)$, ball $S=4\pi R^2$.

$S_1=2\pi\cdot5(5+4)=90\pi$

$l=\sqrt{15^2+8^2}=17$, $S_2=\pi\cdot15(15+17)=480\pi$

$S_3=4\pi\cdot7^2=196\pi$

1 → B;  2 → D;  3 → C

en.solution_md:
Formulas: cylinder $S=2\pi R(R+h)$, cone $S=\pi r(r+l)$, ball $S=4\pi R^2$.

$S_1=2\pi\cdot6(6+4)=120\pi$

$l=\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10$, $S_2=\pi\cdot8(8+10)=144\pi$

$S_3=4\pi\cdot7^2=196\pi$

1 → F;  2 → D;  3 → B
en.mistake_note_md: Computing only the lateral surface instead of the total one, or using the height instead of the slant height in the cone.

questions.solution_md:
O'q kesimi — tomonlari $2R$ va $h$ bo'lgan to'g'ri to'rtburchak: $S=2Rh$, bundan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{24}{8}=3$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot4^2\cdot3=48\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: O'q kesimi yuzini $Rh$ deb olish (diametr o'rniga radius): balandlik ikki barobar katta chiqib, hajm noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

ru.solution_md:
Осевое сечение — прямоугольник со сторонами $2R$ и $h$: $S=2Rh$, откуда $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{24}{8}=3$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot4^2\cdot3=48\pi$.

kaa.solution_md:
Kósher kesim — tárepleri $2R$ hám $h$ bolǵan tuwrı tórtmúyeshlik: $S=2Rh$, bunnan $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{24}{8}=3$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot4^2\cdot3=48\pi$.

en.solution_md:
The axial section is a rectangle with sides $2R$ and $h$: $S=2Rh$, so $h=\frac{S}{2R}=\frac{24}{8}=3$.

$V=\pi R^2h=\pi\cdot4^2\cdot3=48\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the section area as $Rh$ (radius instead of diameter): the height comes out twice too large.

questions.stem_md: Silindrning asos radiusi $8$, balandligi $6$. O'q kesimining yuzini toping.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yon sirt formulasida $2\pi rh$ o'rniga $\pi rh$ yoki hajm o'rniga yon sirtni olish; o'q kesimi ($2rh$) da $\pi$ qatnashmaydi.

ru.stem_md: Радиус основания цилиндра равен $8$, высота — $6$. Найдите площадь осевого сечения.
